name: BELL, Sean Fredrick
research_notes: Initial pass 2026-09-17. The first speech supplies a substantially fuller chronology than the frozen occupation labels: video-store shifts; catering; lawn mowing; four years unloading containers through an unidentified labour-hire company; part-time study; self-employed claims-assessment contracting; then One Nation employment after the 2016 double-dissolution election.

The first speech does not provide calendar dates for pre-political spells. The four-year labour-hire duration is retained in evidence but not converted into invented start/end dates or a scalar headline. Waking at 3:30am and 'working hard' does not prove formal full-time status.

The 2016 election occurred before he submitted a resume; he says the job offer came a few months later and the political work lasted nine years. Sources establish year-level 2016–2025 only. Whips clerk/adviser and senior adviser wording may be stages of one employment relationship; they are kept as one non-additive political-staff interval pending payroll records.

The frozen occupation says 'Claims Investigator'; the first speech and party biography say claims assessor, self-employed/own business. Both descriptions are preserved without inventing a business name or assuming professional hours.

Official qualifications include TAFE Queensland Certificate III in Investigative Services and a Griffith University journalism certificate. His first speech says he dropped out of university, later returned to part-time study and obtained qualifications. Education is not employment.

Searches attempted: official parliamentary biography and speeches; One Nation nomination biography; first-speech/Hansard transcript; claims-assessor business name; warehousing/labour history; public profiles; secondary news. Namesakes were excluded. No accessible business registration, resume or payroll dates found.

Follow-up priority: legal business name/ABN and claims contracts; labour-hire employer and four-year endpoints/hours; video-store/catering/lawn employers and dates; precise political staff appointment, employer/payroll entity, leave and cessation. Last attempted 2026-09-17; advance initial nationwide pass before repeating.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01: added national party secretary and executive, Queensland secretary appointment reported from OFT records, cartoon production and primary-confirmed feature-film producer credit. The party profile also reports JP qualification; qualification alone does not establish a paid or volunteer service spell.

ABN/business-name, professional-profile, labour-hire and full-time searches did not identify a reliably matched pre-politics employer or person-specific hours. Gorilla Labour Hire Perth profile, UK QBE/US insurance workers, overseas producer, university researcher and Australian endurance athlete are unverified namesakes and not adopted. APH registrable-interest search returned robots restriction; no bypass attempted.

Remaining: claims business legal name/contracts and cessation, labour-hire company and four-year endpoints/hours, early retail/hospitality/lawn work, political payroll/leave and exact role transitions, party-office pay/terms, production contracting/fees and JP service if any. Follow-up targeted party governance and film evidence rather than repeating the existing first-speech chronology. Last follow-up2026-10-01; retain blocked status and null totals.

Second follow-up2026-10-02: exact full-name/business and claims-employer searches, national party profile and production-credit routes yielded no new identity-safe legal employer, hours or boundaries. National profile corroborates subcontracting only. Counts: nonmaterial follow-up, not a new/enriched employment record.

A report correcting Sean Black campaign-director attribution to Sean Bell national-secretary attribution is a namesake/role warning, not new employment. Other staff full-time references and third-party salary reports cannot establish Bell hours. Film/series credit search still provides outputs not contract boundaries. Next revisit requires publicly identifiable businessregistration or original labourhire/claimscontract chronology; retain all gaps.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: exact-name searches for the claims-assessor business, Queensland claims investigation, labour-hire employer and 2016 appointment produced no identity-safe business or contract record. The prominent Gorilla Labour Hire profile is a Perth namesake and remains excluded. Official biography and first speech only repeat the existing occupation sequence. Do not infer calendar endpoints from the four-year narrative or a legal employer from brand/name matches; advance pending an original registration or contract record.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New targetedfilmproducer fee/contract/unpaid searches and exactfull-name businessqueries found only existing Australianproducer credits and party subcontractingdescription; no separateemploymentcontract,hours or businessidentity. US/Canadianadvertising ExecutiveStrategyDirectorSeanBell on NACEUnpaidIsUnfaircampaign and UK/otherdefence/athlete namesakes are not identity-linked and not adopted. Correct prior checkpointnext-lead wording mentioningdefenceservice: no AustralianSenatorBell militaryspell established; that was an unsuitable lead, not a supported fact. Existing productioncredits leavepoliticalstaff/partyrelationship unresolved; four-year manual-labour narrative remains undated.

2026-10-05 renewed exact full-name and qualification-linked claims/business searches found no identity-safe ABN, contract employer, early video-store/catering employer or hours. Full party profile/first-speech excerpts still omit payroll boundaries. New education-linked route supplies TAFE qualification only, not service dates. Arizona estate-agent/former London police and RAAF warrant-officer namesakes explicitly excluded; no defence job adopted. Correct preceding checkpoint label: assigned319142 is Sean Fredrick Bell, not Sam; person_id and member record were correct. Advance until a specific original employer/business lead appears.

Second targeted pass used the senators-interest route for a possible contracting-business identity. Primary January2026 combined interests volume URL https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Senators_Interests/-/media/FB79802AD0754CB3AC0564B082B5C10A.ashx and current register both returned403Forbidden. PlainPolitics secondary summary lists NationalSecretary but no business identity; absence in post-appointment interests is not proof of no earlier business or paid work. No fresh direct employment fact adopted. Exact-full-name and qualification-linked queries produced namesakes, which remain rejected. No repeated general film-credit or aggregate staff-pay inference; next require accessible original Bell declaration or personal contracting registration.
